ResearchProjectDef.label: Dawn of Anima
ResearchProjectDef.description: Begin learning the fundamentals of communing with the anima tree.
ResearchProjectDef.discoveredLetterText:
Your colony has reached the dawn of a new age. An age of harmony with the anima tree.

The anima tree will provide you with many new resources, and new ways to face your challenges.

As an added bonus, all colonists can now meditate at natural meditation foci, such as the anima tree itself.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Anima Shaman
ResearchProjectDef.description: Master your connection to the anima tree, unlocking secrets that are beyond human understanding.
